retraction.reason: Retracted in M42 batch 8 under brief §1: the record earns no honest edge. The English article, at revision 1375005540, argues from the dissolution of Austria-Hungary and the paramilitaries of the late 1920s and forward to the authoritarian constitution of May 1934 and the Fatherland Front, and this atlas holds no Austrian record before the state treaty of 1955. It waits on the Anschluss, on the Dollfuss dictatorship, or on a page that argues a line from it to something here.
